3mtm-vinyl-fine-line-tape-471-indigo-1-8.description: Designed for fine line and critical paint masking, 3M™ Vinyl Tape 471+ is a conformable tape with a semi-translucent backing. This durable tape is flexible and removes cleanly even after bake cycles, without adhesive build-up or ghosting. Use it on flat, curved, or compound surfaces to ensure exceptional paint lines in a variety of painting applications across a broad spectrum of industries.
